alkylation reagent: alkylation by final 10 mM iodoacetamide (37 °C, 30 min with agitation)
alkylation concentration: alkylation by final 10 mM iodoacetamide (37 °C, 30 min with agitation)
cleavage agent: The gels spanning molecular weight region between 15 and 25 kDa were excised for in-gel trypsin digestion under aseptic conditions.
collision energy: fragmented by a higher-energy collisional dissociation (HCD) workflow at 30 collision energy.
enrichment method: Mitochondrial fractions were prepared from the homogenates of cerebellum tissues from mice by mitochondria isolation kit (130-096-946, Miltenyi Biotec)
fragmentation method: fragmented by a higher-energy collisional dissociation (HCD) workflow at 30 collision energy.
instrument: The mass spectrometry analysis was performed on a Thermo Fisher Scientific™ Orbitrap Fusion™ Tribrid™ mass spectrometer
ionization type: equipped with a nanospray interface (Proxeon, Odense, Denmark).
labeling: Label-free quantification was performed using the peak area of each precursor ion calculated from extracted ion chromatogram
reduction reagent: Following reduction using final 5 mM Tris (2-carboxyethyl) phosphine hydrochloride (TCEP, cat# C4706, Sigma-Aldrich)
reduction concentration: Following reduction using final 5 mM Tris (2-carboxyethyl) phosphine hydrochloride (TCEP, cat# C4706, Sigma-Aldrich)
